name: pool-maintenance
//: The budget domain of the pool maintenance onevcs.toml declares: its budgets.yaml and the measurement that exists only for it. That measurement builds the workspace twice and times a real prune, so it is `budgets-host` alone, which no per-change path reaches: neither this project's `check` nor `just check`, `just test` or `just gate` names it, and the release pull request runs the same check after its gate (`just pool-maintenance-budget`, which runs this command directly, in .github/workflows/ci.yml). It depends on no other project; the only edge is the one `workspace` has to every project.

bootstrap.//: The pinned pruner is installed by the justfile's own `bootstrap` recipe, from the one pin the `pool-maintenance` recipe runs, rather than by a target here.

format.//: Uncached: it rewrites the tree in place.

lint.//: Syntax only: running the check builds a scratch workspace, so it is `test`.

typecheck.//: Declared and empty, because `nx affected` fans out by target name; a shell script has no type-checking step.

test.//: Runs the measurement over a scratch workspace of three tiny crates, never this repository's own target directory, so it costs seconds and can sit on the per-change path `budgets-host` stays off. The justfile is an input because the pruner's pin and the recipe the measurement runs are there.

coverage.//: Declared and empty: there is no line coverage for a shell script.

options.command: bun run onebudgetspec check pool-maintenance/budgets.yaml --label host

budgets-host.//: Wall-clock time on the host that runs it, so never cached. Not a dependency of `check` and not a target `just test` selects. Its settings are declared here rather than as nx.json target defaults: Nx treats any nx.json edit as touching every project, which would open the live lanes for a change to this project alone. There is no cached `budgets` target here, because `just test` selects that name on every affected project and this project's only budget is host-labelled.
